'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Nate Muth LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nate Muth]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Nate Dog Muth
* '''Deck name:''' SIX-BITCH
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
